description: Read-only continuity reminders. Requires Codex hook review and trust. No file writes, transcript access, Git operations or task creation.

hooks.command: echo 'Project continuity for Platforma.Market: before acting read the current repository AGENTS.md and the task-continuity section in actual_docs/governance/DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md. Read the checkpoint for the selected task only. After compaction or handoff verify cwd, branch, HEAD, dirty ownership and evidence. Preserve the latest authorized scope and the single-owner rule. Maintain a compact checkpoint at meaningful milestones when file writes are authorized. Do not repeat completed work or reset failed-check attempts. A new session is not authorization for code changes, new tasks, archiving or Git mutations. If the task or checkpoint is ambiguous, ask instead of guessing.'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Write-Output 'Project continuity for Platforma.Market: before acting read the current repository AGENTS.md and the task-continuity section in actual_docs/governance/DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md.
